pins.definition: To say or write something in return to a question, message, or action.
To say or write something in response to someone or something.
To give a reply to someone, a question, or a message.

situation: A teacher stands in front of a classroom pointing to a question on the chalkboard while a girl raises her hand to speak.
subject: the verbal reply
brief: A young girl at a wooden school desk sits with her hand raised high, her mouth open mid-word as she speaks her reply toward the front of the room. A teacher stands beside a green chalkboard where a chalked question mark hangs above them.
prompt: A young girl at a wooden school desk sits with her hand raised high, her mouth open mid-word as she speaks her reply toward the front of the room. A teacher stands beside a green chalkboard where a chalked question mark hangs above them. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
